identity_warnings: HYDRA Gorgon Tomi Shishido is distinct from canonical gorgon (Gorgon Petragon of Attilan).
James Taylor James is also called J.T. Slade in Marvel publisher editorial; alias normalization requires crosswalk review.
Fury’s individualized recruiting calls do not prove a specific personal conversation with Yo-Yo; no Daisy–Yo-Yo pair counted solely from team command.
The comic continuity Phobos Alexander Aaron is distinct from MCU or generic mythological references.
